parts.text: We need answer concise, 1-2 sentences. Explain Rust and why memory safety matters. Need maybe mention systems programming language with compile-time ownership/borrow checker preventing memory errors. Why matters: security, crashes, undefined behavior. One or two sentences. Ensure no markdown? Fine.

Rust is a systems programming language that uses compile-time ownership and borrowing rules to guarantee memory safety without a garbage collector. Memory safety matters because it prevents bugs like buffer overflows, use-after-free, and data races that cause crashes, security vulnerabilities, and undefined behavior.
